europe_now.title: After deadly summer in Ukraine and Gaza, EU defence ministers refuse Patriot missiles and sidestep Israel sanctions
europe_now.summary: EU defence ministers have declined to approve Patriot missile systems and avoided imposing sanctions on Israel following a deadly summer in Ukraine and Gaza. The decision reflects a complex balancing of security concerns and diplomatic considerations within the Union.

sources.headline: After deadly summer in Ukraine and Gaza, EU defence ministers refuse Patriot missiles and sidestep Israel sanctions

europe_now.title: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack
europe_now.summary: German authorities have attributed a drone incursion at Leipzig airport to Russian actors. In response, Germany has announced retaliatory measures against the responsible parties.

sources.headline: Germany says Russia behind Leipzig airport drone attack

top_stories.title: EU officials confirm ban on Brazilian meat and dairy amid health concerns
top_stories.summary: EU officials have confirmed a ban on Brazilian meat and dairy products citing health concerns. The measure reflects the Union's regulatory response to food safety issues originating from Brazil.

sources.headline: EU officials confirm ban on Brazilian meat and dairy amid health concerns

top_stories.title: Norway's new king takes oath following his predecessor's death
top_stories.summary: Norway's new monarch has taken the oath of office following the death of his predecessor. The ceremony was attended by mourners paying respects to the late king.
